Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1448.jpg'}
{3: 'The night rain over Port Podesta has not let up.'}
{3: 'Outside the window, red streaks of light slide down the glass, throwing distorted shadows onto the floor.'}
{3: 'Inside, the room is quiet. Only the sound of the rain remains.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1448.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1448.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: 'The young woman lies on the bed, her lips moving faintly. Her limbs still twitch from time to time.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Ophelia...', 4: '15'}
{3: "Helentine kneels by the bed, her sleeves pushed past her elbows, binding the girl's bleeding wounds tight with gauze."}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "I've done what I can for now.", 4: '15'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "But something's wrong... Her pulse is barely there, and she's so cold.", 4: '15'}
{3: 'She speaks without lifting her fingers from the bandages.'}
{3: "A mechanical spider lowers itself from the ceiling, its tiny legs testing the air before landing softly on Helentine's fingertip."}
{3: 'She lets the slight, cool weight rest on her knuckle, then slowly closes her palm around it.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1448.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1448.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: '...I\'ve made some "adjustments" to the hotel\'s central system.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Wynne, and this...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "I'm Leia! Hi, nice to meet you!", 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'And Leia... will both be registered as local residents now. That should keep you two from running into any more identity issues, or at least spare you some trouble.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Helentine pauses to consider her words, then looks at the woman dressed like a reporter.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "Wynne... It's been a long time, hasn't it?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Oh? You two know each other?', 4: '18'}
{3: 'Helentine parts her lips, groping for the right words. It feels as though she has too much to say and nothing she can grasp at all.'}
{2: 'Wynne', 3: 'I mean... we were friends, a long time ago, I think. But... huh?', 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest02.prefab'}
{1: '1', 3: "A sharp pain stabs between Wynne's brows. She presses a hand to her head, the words she was about to say suddenly gone."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest02.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest03.prefab'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest03.prefab'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1448.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1448.jpg'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Helentine shuts her eyes, and only after a long hesitation does she slowly begin to speak.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Both you and Ophelia should...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Helentine pauses for a moment.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'You should have... died back in 2163. Because of the Punishing Virus.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'As a war correspondent who fell in the line of duty, Wynne.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wynne', 3: '...What? Helentine, what are you saying?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Wynne goes rigid.'}
{2: 'Wynne', 3: '2163? War correspondent? Punishing Virus? Me?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She points to herself.'}
{2: 'Wynne', 3: "I've been in Port Podesta this whole time, though?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wynne', 3: 'Wait... Look, my camera still has all my photos from these past years. Let me show you...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V460jianbao01.png'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Without waiting for her to finish, Helentine slips a yellowed newspaper clipping from her notebook.'}
{3: 'It is a list of casualties. Fourth row, fifth column. The name "Wynne" is right there.'}
{3: "Tucked behind the list is a war correspondent's ID from that time."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'I went to confirm it at the time... I was hoping it was just someone else with the same name.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'I found this among your personal effects.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wynne', 3: "I... I don't remember ever having this ID...", 4: '1'}
{3: "Wynne's mouth opens, but nothing comes out."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest02.prefab'}
{3: "Another sharp pain rips through Wynne's nerves."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest02.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest03.prefab'}
{3: 'Wynne grabs fistfuls of her own hair, slips from the couch, and drops to her knees on the floor.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest03.prefab'}
{3: 'Leia finds the painkillers and guides Wynne back onto the couch, steadying her.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wynne', 3: 'What have I... been doing all these years...?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wynne', 3: "...No, wait. I... these last few years. I wasn't in Port Podesta. Port Podesta wasn't like this.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: "...Rest for now, Wynne. Don't try to piece together the past just yet. We'll talk more once you're feeling a little better.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Wynne gives a vacant nod. Leia eases her back onto the sofa and pulls the blanket snug around her.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'The room settles into silence. Only the rain outside the window can be heard.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "So from what you said earlier... Ophelia's in the same boat as Wynne?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Her voice sounds different from usual. The playful lilt at the end of her sentences is gone.'}
{2: "It's hard to make sense of any of this right now...", 3: '162'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: 'When Wynne first told me, I thought it was just rumors...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Leia, what exactly brought you to Port Podesta?', 3: '164'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "Uh... it's a whole thing. Long story short... someone robbed a tomb.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Leia digs a newspaper out of Wynne's bag and unfolds it across the table."}
{3: 'The front-page headline is circled in red ink: "Erhorn Family Cemetery Burglarized."'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: 'Intel came in about a grave robbery, and a body was stolen. I followed the trail. Every lead pointed here, to Port Podesta.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: 'Once I got here, a contact put me in touch with Wynne. I figured the whole "dead coming back" thing was just hearsay, but now...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She looks at Wynne, still shivering on the couch, then over at Ophelia lying in the bed.'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: 'Man... what a mess. What is even going on here?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'We came to investigate traces of an agent.', 3: '177'}
{2: 'And ever since we arrived... things have been strange.', 3: '178'}
{2: 'At the banquet, the people on the streets... they were all off.', 3: '179'}
{2: 'Tavis has been watching us the entire time, too.', 3: '180'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'My father... is the most likely suspect.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'The Spelmin family has always governed Port Podesta. Father would never allow anyone to disrupt the order here.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "If an agent really is in Port Podesta, if the dead really are returning, there's no way he doesn't know.", 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "That's what the people in the port district think too. People have been disappearing for a while now. A lot of them have come down with something. The symptoms are just like what Ophelia and Wynne are going through.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "The Tidal Hub is connected to the whole city's groundwater. Everyone's convinced something got dumped into the water supply.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "So they've been wanting to investigate what's inside the Tidal Hub. And they're willing to help Wynne and me get past the border wall, into the city proper.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: "The Tidal Hub... That's my father's property too.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Helentine looks down at her sister's pale face, then lifts her gaze to you beside her."}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: '【kuroname】... We have to go on the offensive now.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "Tomorrow's diplomatic conference is at the Tidal Hub. It's too good an opportunity to pass up.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "Most of Port Podesta's forces will be tied up at the conference. With security spread thin, we'll have an easier time searching the rest of the building.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Father especially will have his attention elsewhere.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assuming we can slip away mid-conference.', 3: '201'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "...For anyone who might get in our way, I'll handle them ahead of time with my spiders.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Her fingertips give a faint twitch.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "I don't have clearance anyway. So I'll head to the Tidal Hub perimeter tomorrow and wait for you two. I'll be your backup.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "Once you shake loose, I'll find a way to meet up with you.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "Uh, I've gotta ask, though... aren't we a little shorthanded here?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: 'This is getting deeper by the second. Should we call this in to Babylonia?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Helentine shakes her head.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "...My father is watching our every move. And he's already on edge about Babylonia's involvement.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'If Babylonia moves in now, we risk tipping him off.', 3: '218'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "Exactly. And we don't have anything solid enough to formally charge him with yet.", 4: '1'}
{2: "I'll contact Gray Raven in code and have them on standby.", 3: '220'}
{2: 'Bringing them into Port Podesta too soon would only alert Tavis.', 3: '221'}
{3: 'Helentine stays quiet for a moment, then her eyes flick toward Ophelia again.'}
{3: "Just then, Wynne's voice comes from the side, weak and unsteady."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wynne', 3: "I'll stay with Ophelia... Don't worry about us...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wynne', 3: "The state I'm in... I'd just hold you back.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Hey. None of that. Lie down and rest.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "We've got Babylonia behind us, and the Gray Raven Commandant right here. How would we even lose?", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Helentine regards Wynne on the couch and says nothing for a moment.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: '...Thank you, Wynne.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She looks at her sister one last time, then slips her hand back beneath the blanket and smooths the edge.'}
{2: 'Then we move tomorrow. Primary target: the Tidal Hub.', 3: '242'}
{2: 'If anyone picks up anything suspicious, report it immediately.', 3: '243'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'Beyond the window, a brighter flash of lightning splits the night.'}
{3: 'The room bleaches white for a heartbeat, then settles back into its dim, damp quiet.'}

{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageLoop3.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '13'}
{1: '1', 3: 'A dense grid of holographic screens floats in the air, slicing every corner of the city into countless fragments.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Streets, the port, storefronts along Hillston Street, hotel corridors, the entrance to the Tidal Hub...'}
{2: '????', 3: 'Heh. How can a dead person have an identity?', 4: '1'}
{2: '????', 3: "A little spider's trick is nowhere near as efficient as the Punishing Virus...", 4: '1'}
{2: '????', 3: 'Let me lend you a helping hand.', 4: '1'}
{3: "The man cloaked in shadow taps the screen, silently pulling up the records of a deceased individual from Port Podesta's database."}
{2: 'Central System', 3: 'Identity verified. ▆▅▃▅, welcome to Port Podesta.'}
{2: '????', 3: 'Grant administrator permissions to Helentine Spelmin.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Central System', 3: 'Helentine Spelmin, permission authentication complete.'}
{2: '????', 3: "Don't thank me... I'm only hoping you uninvited guests might disturb the Sefirah's slumber a little.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He chuckles quietly and swipes away the hotel room feed, the "scheme" dismissed. The next scene loads: inside the Tidal Hub.'}
{3: 'Lithos and Tavis still stand before the vast observation window, their eyes fixed on the Sefirah beyond the glass.'}
{2: '????', 3: "All my pieces are on the board, Lithos. It's your move now.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1525.jpg'}

{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: 'On the screen, Lithos seems to be staring absently off to one side.'}
{3: 'He tilts his head a fraction, then slowly turns his gaze toward the center of the lens.'}
{3: 'Through the screen, he appears to look past all the data and static, straight at the man watching from the other side.'}
